title: TOR330 Full Track (GPX), 2026
claims: The full-course GPX URL resolves and returns GPX 1.1 data created with Garmin Desktop App.
The file metadata contains only a Garmin link and a creation timestamp of 2026-08-14, with no copyright or redistribution licence statement.
The track bounds span latitudes 45.548 to 45.880 N and longitudes 6.921 to 7.930 E.
The file contains waypoints named BaseVita-Valgrisenche, BaseVita-Cogne, BaseVita-Donnas, BaseVita-Gressoney, BaseVita-Valtournenche and BaseVita-Ollomont.
Life Base waypoints carry the description 'Base vita - Base vie - Life base Docce - Douches - Showers Medico - Medecin - Doctor Barriera oraria - Barriere horaire - Time deadline'.
The BaseVita-Valgrisenche waypoint is at 45.630 N / 7.063 E with an elevation of 1,686 m.
The organiser also publishes seven split GPX files named START–Life Base 1 through Life Base 6–FINISH.
